insight: Acquired by Canva in July 2024 (reported at $320M+); the Sydney startup builds its own image models, Phoenix and Lucid Origin.
name: Leonardo.Ai
tagline: Generate and control production-grade images with purpose-built models.
description: AI image and video generation platform aimed at creators and studios, built on Leonardo's own foundational models (Phoenix, Lucid Origin). Offers fine-grained control — ControlNet-style guidance, reusable 'Elements', a real-time canvas, and image-to-motion — for game art, concept work, and marketing visuals.
edge: Pairs its own Phoenix/Lucid Origin models with fine-grained controls (ControlNet, Elements, real-time canvas) aimed at production game and concept art.
cons: Heavy use needs a paid plan

references.title: Canva buys Australian AI design startup Leonardo.ai
